title: Grok Build launches terminal coding agent #grokbuild #codingagent #aicoding
description:
Grok Build introduced a terminal-native coding agent built to handle complex software tasks with parallel AI execution. The launch centers on four standout capabilities: up to eight agents working on different parts of a project at once, headless mode for scripts and automations, ACP support for custom orchestration, and a 2 million token context window.

That combination points to a major shift in AI-assisted development from single-threaded code generation to multi-agent software production. By keeping an entire codebase in memory and generating a full step-by-step plan before making changes, Grok Build is positioned as a more controllable and scalable tool for developers working across large repositories.

The broader significance is speed, reliability, and automation. For engineers, teams, and AI builders, the product suggests a future where coding agents operate inside existing terminal workflows, integrate into automated pipelines, and take on more of the planning and execution layer of software development.
